entries.title: Fewer short pauses each minute with Automation rules or the Heartbeat on
entries.body: Once a minute the app checks your Automation rules, and with the Heartbeat on it also reads your waiting work. That check read every connection once for each rule and repeated slow preparation for each waiting task, so the window could pause briefly every minute. It now reads your connections once and reuses that preparation, so the check takes about a millisecond.
entries.noPicture: The fix changes how long a background check takes, not how any view looks.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page describes how long the minute check takes.
